verdicts.reason: The two candidates are nearly identical, and both make the same move: they pull the decorative circles fully into the canvas, so the yellow circle now sits as a big disc behind the whole text block and the peach circle frames the CTA. This loses the original's cropped-corner accents and makes the right side feel lopsided. In both, the chip labels are tiny, around 6–7px, and hard to read. A spaces the SOLSTICE wordmark, headline, subline and chips slightly more evenly, while B pushes the wordmark tighter to the headline, so I give A a marginal edge.
